issues.title: Missing Status Update
issues.description: The step does not update process.json to set status to 'completed'
issues.impact: Process status remains 'running' even after successful completion
issues.recommendation: Add process.json to files.update and add substep to update status

issues.title: Missing Directory Migration
issues.description: No substep exists to move the process directory from active/ to completed/
issues.impact: Completed processes remain in .user-processes/active/, contradicting documentation
issues.recommendation: Add substep for directory migration with instructions for agent to move directory

issues.title: Missing Completion Timestamp
issues.description: No action to update log.json metadata with completion timestamp
issues.recommendation: Add action to set log.json metadata.completed timestamp
